## Statement · **draft**
Let $G$ be a group. Define the **lower central series** inductively by

$\gamma_0 = G, \qquad \gamma_{i+1} = [G, \gamma_i] = \langle\, [g, x] : g \in G,\ x \in \gamma_i \,\rangle .$
